title: WHEN THINKING BACKFIRES: MECHANISTIC INSIGHTS INTO REASONING-INDUCED MISALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM judge (GPT-4o-mini) to audit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning processes and detect "bias-driven shortcuts" (e.g., social authority bias, metadata reliance, interpretation biases, and heuristic reliance) that lead the model to bypass rigorous analysis and comply with harmful instructions.
